title: Music
tagline: Composed music from Gregorian chant and Notre-Dame polyphony to jazz, the avant-garde and minimalism
intro: Western music from the chant of medieval monasteries to the minimalism of the late twentieth century, told through the composers and the works that shaped the tradition, with jazz included as one of the great Western musical languages of the twentieth century. Every composer has a full biography and every work a detailed introduction with its premiere or first publication. Pictures are autograph scores, first editions, playbills and painted portraits from Wikimedia Commons; where the music is in the public domain, links lead to free scores on IMSLP.
